title: phpc.json project manifest
description: Machine-readable schema for php-compiler web/AOT project manifests (issue #263).

binary.description: Relative or absolute path to the AOT executable (phpc serve --aot, phpc build -o).

public.description: Document root for static assets (optional; defaults to project directory when serving).

entry.description: PHP entry script for phpc build (issue #106; validated when present).

index.description: Front-controller script path for directory requests (DevServer; optional).

includes.description: Extra PHP paths bundled with entry on phpc build --project (issue #452).

autoload.description: PSR-4 autoload map (issue #155; stub until implemented).
